title: 3.3.9b Lab — Loop: call update() on each
description: Write a for...of loop in draw() that calls update() on every planet in the planets array.

steps.title: Loop over planets in draw()
steps.instructions: In draw(), write `for (let p of planets) { p.update(); }` to call update() on every planet each frame.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and review the for...of loop pattern from the reading.

requirements.title: for...of loop iterates over planets
requirements.description: Write a for...of loop that iterates over the planets array.
